source_evidence.behavior: The engine invokes the callback synchronously before the ghost, with one-based column, TapNoteScore and brightness, and honors three optional return values.
Returned scores accept exact enum strings, legacy short names case-insensitively, or numeric enum values.
Completed tap rows dispatch NoteField events; the unsigned bright threshold uses combo or Blind. Mine events at line 2943 remain dim.
Player BrightGhostComboThreshold is -1, compared unsigned by Player.cpp.
GameplayMargins derives outer and combined center margins using fake style width 272 and the Simply Love X metrics.
SafeFArg truncates the outer margins and combined center margin before splitting the latter in half.
SafeFArg returns int despite its name.
The actual Player position uses the converted margins. At width 854, P1 is 213.25 and P2 is 640.75.
Modern SSC descriptions use ASCII-only Trim. Before version 0.74 DESCRIPTION names the chart instead.

regressions: A callback runs before visual masking and every same-column ghost, remapping score, column and brightness.
Suppressing a mine ghost does not suppress its original hit sound.
Optional Lua returns follow native numeric, enum and boolean conversions independently.
Production gameplay autoplay invokes the retained Lua callback before Actor Update, feeds the current song clock and stage stats, and the new foreground tween consumes that frame delta.
Player margins cover cabinet sides, two players, centered single/double play, four widths and the authored field offset.

File and memory SSC parsing preserve non-ASCII description whitespace and escaped colon, keep independent credit/name fields and retain legacy description handling. Cache version 65 invalidates old metadata.
